title: the season
description: Every night out since January 2023, named from the calendar rather than found in the step counts — which is why the club nights and indoor festivals are in it at all. From May 2025 a watch stayed on, so each night also carries what it cost: steps, the HRV drop the morning after, how little sleep, and how many nights back to baseline. Before that it is a ledger of dates and names, which is all the phones left behind. Scroll to travel it left to right.
